content_fields.title: Verify database traffic is validated
content_fields.description: Verify that database traffic validation is operating.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means issuing a representative anomalous statement and confirming the monitor detects and alerts on it.
content_fields.missing: The monitoring component that would generate the detection.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification cannot be performed without the monitoring layer.
content_fields.action: The security operations team should verify detection once monitoring is deployed.
